signal: Prove (formerly Payfone) launched its unified Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world (April 2026) and announced partnerships with authID, Ownera, Trinsic, and Spinwheel.

email.body1:
Michael, saw Prove launch the unified Identity Platform and stack up partnerships with authID, Trinsic, and Spinwheel.

When that much demand lands at once, SDR teams usually generate more interest than reps can follow up on fast enough, and ramp time makes it worse. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to your top three target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Prove.

With a platform launch and new partners driving inbound, response speed and follow-up volume are usually where reps fall behind, especially newer ones still ramping. Our best-practice changes alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of Prove's current outbound, three things I would change, and how each frees your reps to spend more time in conversations.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other B2B SaaS SDR teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Michael, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If taking follow-up and ramp pressure off your SDRs is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters right after a platform launch, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your team? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
